title: Aureline M5 go/no-go decision
description: Canonical per-domain record for the certified-archetype cohort. Names the resolved go/no-go decision, the operational-readiness review signoff, the preserved evidence snapshot and named on-call / signoff roster that justified widening, and the widening stage it authorizes so a stable claim never widens without a go/no-go decision and shiproom never implies green while go/no-go or ORR state is stale. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a cohort's go/no-go posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
